item.title: A Treasure in Every Yid: Parshas Terumah with a Geulah Lens
item.description: In a generation where so many adults, teens, and children alike are grappling with self-worth, comparison, and the question of “Do I really matter?”, the Rebbe’s last message of Parshas Terumah lands with great relevance. Full Story

item.title: How Young Is Too Young for Social Media?

item.title: Parshas Shekalim One Sefer Torah or Two?
item.description: Question: When the aron kodesh was opened for Krias HaTorah this past Shabbos, we realized that the Shekalim Sefer Torah had not been rolled; it was still at the Rosh Chodesh kriah in parshas Pinchos. What was the correct thing to do? Answer by Rabbi Mendel Prescott, Rosh Yeshiva of Machon Smicha. Full Story
